text:
nina: Heads up — a user reported our 2.2.0-beta.1 package failing on Vercel Edge: their build errors with "ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '/node_modules/@redwood/sdk-js' imported from /var/task/.next/server/pages/index.mjs". Stack shows it's resolving to index.cjs.

ben: I ran `npm pack` locally for the beta and unpacked it — the tarball only contains `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`, no `dist/index.mjs`, no `.map`, and no `index.d.ts`. Our rollup output did generate `.mjs` and maps but publish step uses `git ls-files 'dist/*.js'` in the workflow which misses `.mjs` and `.map`.

tanya: Oof. We switched to a stricter files glob in the monorepo publish action to avoid unrelated files. That inadvertently dropped `.mjs` and `*.map`. Also noticed `package.json` in the package root has `type: \"commonjs\"` from legacy and no `exports` field — that can cause ESM consumers to pick wrong entry.

nina: The user repros on Next-edge and Cloudflare pages (Edge Runtimes). They expect ESM default. For now they pinned to 2.1.x and it fixes their app. Suggest we cut a hotfix beta (or patch) that explicitly includes both artifacts and sets an `exports` map.

ben: Proposed minimal fixes: 1) publish job: change `git ls-files 'dist/*'` so it doesn't filter by ext, or explicitly include `dist/*.mjs` and `dist/*.map`; 2) package.json: add `main: \"dist/index.cjs\"`, `module: \"dist/index.mjs\"`, `types: \"dist/index.d.ts\"`, and an `exports` map: {\"import\": \"./dist/index.mjs\", \"require\": \"./dist/index.cjs\"}. Also ensure top-level `type` is absent or set appropriately.

ci-bot: CI note: pack-check failed in previous run — we added a lint that checks `files` globs but didn't run on the beta branch. I queued a re-run of the pack-check job on the beta tag.

leo: One gotcha: our monorepo uses pnpm workspace. The `prepare` script that builds `dist/` runs during `npm pack` only if the workspace package has `publishConfig` set correctly. In some CI runs `prepare` didn't run due to `pnpm` packing behavior. We should add a CI step that runs the build before packing.

tanya: I pushed a branch `fix/publish-artifacts` that 1) updates publish workflow to `git ls-files \"dist/*\"` 2) adds `dist/*.mjs`, `dist/*.map`, `dist/*.d.ts` to `files` in package.json 3) adds `exports` and `module`/`main` fields 4) ensures `prepare` is invoked in CI before `npm pack`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1259

ben: Also added a tiny smoke test to the release job: `npm pack && tar -xzf *.tgz -C tmp && node --input-type=module -e \"import('./tmp/package/dist/index.mjs').then(()=>console.log('esm ok'))\"` and `node -e \"require('./tmp/package/dist/index.cjs') && console.log('cjs ok')\"`. It will fail the job if either import fails.

nina: Good. Also let's include source maps in the tarball so runtime stack traces on Vercel show original TS lines. Add `sourcemap: true` in rollup and ensure `.map` files are included.

ci-bot: pack-check re-run passed on branch. Tarball contains `dist/index.mjs`, `dist/index.cjs`, `dist/index.js.map`, and `dist/index.d.ts`. Smoke tests passed in ephemeral runner.

leo: We should document in devex/README: publishing checklist for JS packages in monorepo — include steps for pack-check, prepare, types, exports, and pack smoke tests. I'll sketch it.

tanya: Releasing the patch now as `2.2.0-beta.2` (we'll do stable patch soon). Notifying users who opened issues.

nina: Thanks all. Follow-ups: 1) Add pre-publish CI job that builds + pack-check on every release PR 2) Add an automated regression test that installs the tarball in the Next.js example and runs a small serverless build 3) Add a lint rule to fail if `exports` or `types` are missing. I'll file those as issues.

ben: Also check .npmignore vs files precedence — we want `files` to be the source of truth; avoid having .npmignore accidentally exclude maps.

nina: Tracking: #JIRA-DEVEX-456. I'll update release notes to advise pinning to 2.1.x for now and link the beta that contains the fix.
